style.description: One or two sentences that set the look of every picture in this serial's bible: medium, rendering, palette and light. The style in use, word for word, when the input names one.

id.description: The record's id exactly as given, such as characters/ned-land or settings/the-salon.

prompt.description: Three to five sentences an image model paints from: what can be seen of the person or the place. No names, no plot, no style, no framing.
